p.i: Qui beneficium in indignum confert, idem reportabit premium, quod reportavit alim Senemmarus.

main_text.p: اشأم من دسوس Ominosior Basusa.] Basus, foemina, quae cum nepotem suum Iassasum ad vindictam ob interfectam Sarebum ( quod cujusdam quem ipsa hospitio exceperat, Camelae nomen ) à Colaibo sumendam incitaret, causa extitit belli annorum 40.

p. 152.Qui Dhafarum ingreditur Hamyarismum addiscat.] Iis quae ad hujus explicationem facientia, dicta sunt, pag. 152. addc è libro Temthal dixisse Arabem istum ليعلمن الملك اني سامع مطيع Sciat Rex me ipsius dicto audientem fore. Alii verbum حمر aliter exponunt, scil. Vestes rubro colore tinget [vel tingat] quod scil. in Dhafaro fodinae sint rubricae quae مغرة dicitur. يضرب للرجل اذا خالط القوم احن بينهم Monet eum qui populo alicui se adjungit, ut ad eorum mores & habitum se adtemperet. Temthal.

p. 163.اخطب من سحبان وائل Facundior Sabbano Wayelensi] Sabban (inquit Alfaubarius) اسم رجل من وائل كان لسانا بليغا يضرب به المثل في البيان Nomen viri è tribu Wayel, facundi, adeo ut in proverbium abieris ejus eloquentia, qui de se dixit لقد علم الحي اليمانون اذا قلت اما بعد أني خطيبهم Norunt tribus Yamanenses, me ubi dixerim Emmabaad ipsorum oratorem esse.
p. 231.Asinus AlSheichi وقف حمار الشيخ علي الغفارة [?]

page.notes: The Arabic is copied as far as legible but several words are doubtful and are not individually marked; check them against the scan. Arabic words near the Latin 'Dhafarum', 'Temthal' and 'Sabban' lines are approximate. The catchword "[feu" is read as a catchword at the foot of the column; it may be the start of a Latin/Arabic word. Printed Latin 'Basus', 'Iassasum' and 'Sarebum' are doubtful in their long-s forms and were written with plain s. The Greek-letter "Wayel" line and the words 'Emmabaad' and 'Senemmarus' are copied as printed but are not verified.
